Leo

I don't think you need to ply the depths of the object created by summary​, but rather the object created by ds​.  Here's a toy example using the minke​ data set that contains two strata:

library(Distance)
data("minke")
mink <- ds(minke, key="hr", truncation=1.5)

Have a look at str(mink)​, you will see stratum-specific abundance estimates located here:

print(mink$dht$individuals$N)
  Label  Estimate        se        cv      lcl       ucl       df
1 North 12181.419 4638.6284 0.3807954 5499.950 26979.692 12.96781
2 South  3653.345  910.0975 0.2491135 2181.595  6117.971 17.96263
3 Total 15834.764 4834.2848 0.3052957 8388.423 29891.167 15.25496

and stratum-specific density estimates here:

print(mink$dht$individuals$D)

Hope that gets you what you want.

Subject: [distance-sampling] Extract density estimates from summary.dsmodel object
 
Hi all,

Simple question -- I have a large summary.dsmodel object that I need to extract 50 rows of density estimates from.  I cant seem to find information on the syntax for extracting the density estimates.  Is it some form of using my.summary.dsmodel$dht?

Thanks,
